text.text: Many routes have little or no shade, leaving people in strong sun and heat, most of all in the middle of the day.
Pipes along the roadside narrow the walking space, so people step around them, close to passing traffic.
Six obstacles to walking in Malé. Illustrations by the Malé group.

text.text: Lack of shade and heat exposure
Vehicles park tight against the pavement edge, leaving less room to walk and no safe way to step off it.
